context: A long lazy Sunday at Goro's house. Both Sho and Hina are visiting. Goro decides to tell them a story he hasn't told in fifty years.
purpose: three-speaker oral-history — grandfather, two grandkids, one true story

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: You two — sit. There's a story.
lines.style: A small slow Kyushu summoning — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A bright eight-year-old anticipation — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A small careful single — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: おじいちゃんの、お父さんの話な。
lines.en: A story about my own father.
lines.style: A small slow introduction — genuine and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A bright kid-awe — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: うん。…戦争の、すぐ後やった。
lines.style: A small careful frame. Voice low.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A small careful question — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: うん。…おじいちゃんも、子供だった、その時。
lines.en: Mm. …I was a child then, too.
lines.style: A small slow personal frame — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A small wide-eyed kid-line — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 本当に。…ある日、本当に、知らん人が、家に来た。
lines.en: Truly. …One day — a complete stranger came to the door.
lines.style: A small story-beat. Voice drops — genuine and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A small kid-empathy question — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 怖かった、本当に。…でも、その人、優しい人やった。
lines.en: I was — truly. …But that person — was a kind person.
lines.style: A small slow turning of the story.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A small kid-curious line — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: おにぎり、一つ。…本当に、その時の味、忘れんかった。
lines.en: A single onigiri. …I never forgot the taste.
lines.style: A small precious memory — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A real silent beat. The kid taking it in.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Did you see that person again?
lines.style: A small careful follow-up — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: いいや。…でも、大切な人やった。一緒におった時間、短くても。
lines.en: No. …But a precious person. Even though the time together was short.
lines.style: A small closing wisdom — genuine and unforced throughout.
